VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: infinity
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Passive. An infinite series of halves stands between Gojo and everything else. Bullets, blades and fists slow as they approach and never quite arrive.

Always on. Each attack stopped costs a little neural heat; Infinity drops, and attacks get through, once heat hits its limit (until heat cools to half) or psyfocus runs out (until 5% has come back).

While Infinity is up, poison never reaches him: no tox gas, rot stink, toxic fallout, venom or food poisoning. He never catches fire, and a stopped attack does not stagger him.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: cursed technique lapse: blue
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: A point of negative infinity. Gojo sets it where he looks, and everything nearby falls into it hard enough to be hurt: people, items, walls, trees, the ground itself. It leaves a crater.\n\nThe orb flies to the target and holds there for a few seconds. The more psyfocus Gojo has when it lands, the wider it pulls: up to twice as wide on a full bar. If it reaches one of Gojo's Reds, the two become Hollow Purple.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: blue fist
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Passive. A small Blue sits in Gojo's fist, so whatever he punches is already falling toward it. His unarmed hits land harder and more surely, and the target is staggered.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: black flash
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Passive. Cursed energy landing within a millionth of a second of the blow, and the space around the impact flashes black. Nobody does it on purpose, but Gojo does it more often than anyone.\n\nAny damaging hit may crit for 2.5x with sharply raised armour penetration, healing Gojo, returning psyfocus and purging neural heat. Chance and every number scale with psychic sensitivity.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: blue: acceleration
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Gojo pulls himself along with small Blues, toward wherever he is going next. He moves and strikes far faster than anyone should.\n\nHeld on; costs psyfocus for as long as it is up.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: reverse cursed technique
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Negative energy multiplied against itself produces positive energy, and the body repairs itself without being told to. With the Six Eyes running the numbers, Gojo's is faster and cheaper than anyone's.\n\nSpeed scales with how much psyfocus is in the pool. Nearby allies are healed more slowly. Switched on and off with this button. Costs psyfocus every second while on (Six Eyes halves it), and stops at zero psyfocus or maximum neural heat. Poison makes healing cost double, up to triple as toxic buildup nears deadly.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: cursed energy reinforcement
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Cursed energy coats Gojo's body: harder skin, heavier blows, faster feet.\n\nAlways on at half strength once learned. The button raises his cursed energy output to full, costing psyfocus every second while on (Six Eyes halves it). Scales with psychic sensitivity.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: cursed technique reversal: red
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Infinity reversed with positive energy: repulsion. Gojo makes an orb of red force and either lets it go, so it flies to the target and waits there until something touches it or flies through it, then bursts and flings everything outward, wider the more psyfocus he had when it landed (up to twice as wide) (a Blue reaching it makes Hollow Purple instead), or holds it and fires it as a beam that hammers everything along the line backward.\n\nThe mode is chosen with the Red button beside it.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: teleportation
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Blue pulling him toward the destination, Red pushing him off the start. Gojo crosses the distance in no time at all.\n\nThis button moves him anywhere on the map, through walls. The Teleport: far button beside it sends him to any tile on the planet.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: hollow technique: purple
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Blue and Red, brought together. The collision makes imaginary mass that erases whatever it passes through: not breaks, erases.

Cast, it is one fast orb of purple that tears a line across the map.

It also comes from his other two techniques: any Blue of Gojo's that reaches one of his waiting Reds bursts into Purple where they meet, erasing everything as far as Blue's pull. That costs nothing more and works even while this psycast is cooling down.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: domain expansion: infinite void
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Gojo's innate domain, closed behind a barrier. Inside is infinite information, and everything inside has to take all of it in at once: anyone who is not his ally is paralysed for as long as the domain lasts, and for a while after.

The barrier keeps people in and out until it is broken. Gojo's touch shares only what he chooses, so whoever he is fighting hand to hand is spared, until they separate.

Opening a domain is a huge strain: it adds half of Gojo's neural heat limit at once.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: blue: pull
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: A flick of Blue. One person or loose item is dragged straight to Gojo's side.\n\nComes with Blue. Costs 1% psyfocus and 3 neural heat (Six Eyes halves the psyfocus).

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: red: push
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: A flick of Red. One person or loose item is thrown away from Gojo, about eight cells, farther with psychic sensitivity. Someone thrown into a wall before then is hurt by it.\n\nComes with Red. Costs 2% psyfocus and 6 neural heat (Six Eyes halves the psyfocus).

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: fly
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description: Gojo stands on nothing. While on, he travels through the air wherever he is sent, over walls, water, people and everything else on the ground, half again as fast as he walks, as long as no roof is in the way. Where the only way is under a roof, he walks.\n\nCosts a little psyfocus every second while on (Six Eyes halves it), and he comes down when psyfocus runs out.
